title: Panel Edit Proposal 0.1
description: An external Agent edit proposal bound to an exact program-generated edit context. It is input, never a success receipt or user approval.
$comment: Register panel-patch.schema.json and all three PanelSpec schemas under their declared IDs. src/edit-planning.mjs validates the context, hash bindings, one unique decision per patch operation (zero-based operationIndex), and unique unresolved IDs. Only decisions for set-theme and set-layout may use design-choice; all other operations require request-interpretation. JSON Schema cannot use operationIndex to look up the corresponding operation, so runtime enforces this relation. Runtime also enforces UTF-16 start < end, source bounds, surrogate-pair boundaries, and quote === context.request.text.slice(start,end). Neither exact quotes nor hashes establish semantic correctness. Any unresolved item blocks application, even when patch is non-null. Runtime applies the whole patch to an isolated source and validates the resulting PanelSpec. READY_TO_APPLY certifies only structural/source evidence and patch-result Spec checks; catalog compilation and actual rendering are still required and semanticReview remains NOT_RUN.

start.description: Inclusive UTF-16 offset in the unchanged context.request.text; must not split a surrogate pair.

end.description: Exclusive UTF-16 offset; runtime checks it against start and the actual source length.

quote.description: Must equal context.request.text.slice(start, end) exactly, with non-whitespace content. Source matching is not proof of semantic correctness.

operationIndex.description: Zero-based index into patch.operations. Runtime requires exactly one decision for each operation and restricts design-choice to set-theme/set-layout.
